Hi Jill / Tom —

Thanks again for the call today — really appreciated the time to walk through Acme's inference use case and the questions on security and controls. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep the procurement/security team moving:

- Requested artifacts: SOC 2 Type II (most recent), bridge letter if the report is older than 12 months, Trust Portal access for your security team to review evidence, and our standard DPA.

Action items (proposed):
1) If you can, confirm who on your side will need Trust Portal access (names + emails).
2) If SOC 2 Type II is required immediately, we can either: (a) provide portal access + redacted report, or (b) provide latest Type I + a bridge letter outlining controls and timeline for the Type II report.
3) Send over the vendor security questionnaire (or a link) and we’ll start populating answers; procurement can use the attached template to standardize the request.

I attached a short SOC2_Request_Template.pdf to make it easy for your procurement team to capture what we typically send. If helpful, I can also create a HubSpot ticket so our security team engages directly.

Proposed timeline: once we have the list of reviewers, we can grant Trust Portal access within 1 business day; bridge letters are typically issued within 1–2 business days after confirmation of access scope.

Would you like me to loop in our security lead (Rishi) now or wait for procurement to formally request access?
